en: [Charge] Locks onto a target within range along the path ahead; movement speed greatly increases for a period of time
Elusive and cannot be blocked; <@eb.key>runs fast</> after being attacked; grants <@eb.key>treasure</> when defeated
An Ursus security guard hired by Duke Duck. Cannot be stunned; grants <@eb.key>treasure</> when defeated
A high-DEF experimental creation that throws rocks causing very long <@eb.key>Stun</>
Throws rocks that cause a very long <$ba.stun>Stun</> (does not target units already <$ba.stun>Stunned</>)
An eccentric with a homemade jetpack who <@eb.key>flies up</> for a while after being blocked
Takes off for a while after being blocked (has a cooldown), during which it cannot be blocked
A security guard severely eroded by Originium. ATK and ASPD increase during <@eb.key>consecutive attacks</>, <@eb.key>reset</> after 4 seconds without attacking
ATK and ASPD increase while continuously attacking (capped); resets after not attacking for several seconds
Greatly weakens the combat ability of friendly units and periodically grants itself a damage-absorbing <@eb.key>shield</>
Halves the ATK and DEF of all friendly units on the battlefield, halves DP regeneration speed, and doubles Redeploy Time
Periodically gains a damage-absorbing <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> proportional to its Max HP
A devoted audience member of the Crimson Troupe. Attacks also deal <@eb.key>Nervous Impairment</>.
An actor of the Crimson Troupe. Attacks also deal <@eb.key>Nervous Impairment</>; after taking a certain number of hits, greatly increases the ASPD of all enemies on the field.
After taking a certain number of hits, immediately greatly increases the ASPD of all current enemies on the field for a short time

Lucien, the Troupe's Calamity, codename Phantom. <@eb.key>Passes through units that block him</> and leaves an <@eb.key>Ominous Phantom</>; attacks and skills also deal <@eb.key>Nervous Impairment</>.
Uses a skill to deal Physical damage to surrounding units; attacks and skills ignore a portion of the target's DEF and also deal <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>
A shadow. Never left, never truly existed.
Has a chance to dodge physical and Arts attacks when not blocked
Attacks and skills ignore a portion of the target's DEF and also deal <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>

Attacks also deal <$ba.dt.erosion>Corrosion Damage</>
[Low-altitude Hovering], attacks also deal <@eb.key>Corrosion Damage</>
<$ba.float>Low-altitude Hovering</>

Attacks <$ba.stun>Stun</> the target
Deals heavy Physical damage to units within the [Dominion]; continuously creates a [Dominion] in an area centered on itself
Deals heavy Physical damage to friendly units within the [Dominion]
Continuously creates a [Dominion] in the 8 tiles around itself, greatly reducing the ASPD of friendly units within
Attacks bounce between 3 targets and inflict Cold, with damage reduced on each bounce; can also attack enemies and bounce between them, increasing their movement speed and ASPD
Attacks inflict <$ba.cold>Cold</> and bounce between 3 targets, with damage reduced on each bounce
[Unnatural Gift] Attacks other enemies and bounces between 3 of them, increasing their movement speed and ASPD
<@eb.key>Stuns</> friendly units after several attacks; its unstable vine structure makes it highly susceptible to fire
When taking damage from the natural environment, gains heavy <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> for a short time
Duke Duck's partner and apprentice, a silver-tongued opportunist.
Physical/Arts damage taken from the front is reduced by 80%
When defeated, throws a cloud of poison mist at the damage source, dealing Arts damage over time.
When defeated, launches a cloud of poison mist at the target that defeated it, continuously dealing Arts damage to its surroundings

When blocked, parasitizes the blocker, dealing Arts damage over time and increasing the Elemental Damage it takes; when the parasitized target suffers an Elemental Burst, it spreads to the 4 surrounding tiles.
When blocked, parasitizes the target; the parasitized target continuously takes Arts damage and takes increased <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Damage</>

When the parasitized target's <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Damage</> bursts, deals a large amount of the same type of <$ba.dt.element>Elemental Damage</> to other friendly units within 4 surrounding tiles
Camouflage; attacks 3 targets at once while Camouflaged.
Attacks multiple targets at once while <$ba.invisible>Camouflaged</>
Grabs up to 3 non-Elite, non-Leader aerial enemies to replenish its ammo; fires a full salvo
Periodically binds and devours several non-Elite, non-Leader aerial enemies, restoring an equal amount of ammo
Expends all ammo at once to deal heavy Physical damage to the target
When defeated, becomes a puppet and grants 5 layers of shield to other nearby enemies; the puppet requires 30 hits to defeat, cannot be blocked, and revives after some time.
